name: SoundSage
tagline: Detects a song's genre and tunes the equaliser for it, entirely on a local AI accelerator.

awards: Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator

problem: Generic EQ presets do not fit specific songs, and cloud analysis costs privacy.
solution: One model classifies genre from audio features trained on about 22,000 clips; a second sets EQ for that genre, both running on an edge accelerator.
demo_moment: Team-described: switch songs and hear the EQ adapt.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator” among 122 submissions.
Trained its own models during the event.

lessons: Use the sponsor's hardware for the job it is built for: local inference.
